name: Ellis
self_text: I am a Canadian man in my 40s. My background is in engineering, and I am currently studying programming. I enjoy birdwatching in my spare time because it is peaceful. I work best when studying independently side by side. I need occasional short exchanges during these sessions. I am not looking for tutoring either way. I can meet in person or online. I am free Saturday morning, Sunday morning, or Sunday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into studying independently side by side. I'd strongly prefer that you are available Saturday morning, Sunday afternoon or Sunday morning, though it's not a requirement. It would matter a lot if you are into programming, but I won't rule you out over it. Ideally, you are okay with complete silence while working or occasional short exchanges, but no big deal.
